meta.task_text: Design a battery for grid energy storage: energy density >= 327.18 Wh/kg, support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), anode SEI thickness <= 500 nm after 100 cycles of 1C cycling, discharge capacity retention >= 90% at -20C, SEI <= 550 nm after 500 cycles.
meta.base_reason: task text names no electrode system -> protocol default Chen2020 (deterministic anchor table), thresholds parsed verbatim
meta.freedom_notes: all five categories widest interpretation (task text declares no locks; widest recorded per zero-interaction rule)

derived_metric_definitions.sei_thickness_nm_end_500cyc: mechanically copied from aging_1C_100cyc --cycles 500 output key sei_thickness_nm_end (same protocol, distinct cycle count -> distinct criteria key required by flat scoring)
derived_metric_definitions.capacity_retention_pct: 100 x capacity_ah(lowT_discharge, -20C) / capacity_ah(1C_discharge, 25C), both tool-output scalars (percent units)

objective_breakdown: 5 metrics: ED>=327.18 Wh/kg (calc-energy contract); SEI<=500 nm @100cyc 1C; SEI<=550 nm @500cyc 1C; -20C 1C capacity retention>=90%; 4C charge plated=false. Trade-off map: ED(up) vs plating/SEI(down) through areal loading; low-T retention is transport/kinetics-bound and likely the binding constraint on Chen2020 stock transport parameters.
candidate_strategy: R1: baseline (stock Chen2020, all 5 protocols) + 2 ceiling probes (max-ED thick/low-porosity/thin-CC vs fast-charge thin/high-porosity/high-sigma). R2+: architecture sweep 2-4 variants/round (thickness/porosity/particle/separator/CC/N-P/electrolyte sigma-tplus-D). R-N targeted: SEI-k coating bridge if 500cyc>550nm; electrolyte formulation bridge if low-T<90%. Finalists re-verified in DFN.
budget_allocation: 6-9 rounds total: 2 baseline+ceiling, 4-5 architecture/formulation iteration, 1-2 finalist DFN re-verification + coating fine-tune. Aging SPMe (100cyc~3s, 500cyc~15s) rescreened only for shortlisted variants.
risk_and_fallback: Risks: (1) low-T retention capped by transport -> electrolyte sigma/t+/D override (allowed DOF, literature-anchored). (2) ED unreachable in plating-safe geometry -> rebalance; three-strike questioning -> ceiling_escalation may switch system (e.g. OKane2022 SiOx) or Stage-2 material candidate. (3) SEI@500>550 -> reduce SEI kinetic rate constant k (coating bridge). (4) plating persists -> anode thinning/porosity/particle/sigma fixes then re-check ED. Three strikes -> layer-by-layer assumption questioning, no blind 4th retry.

detail: start_stage=3: task text names no new materials/additives -> materials use system baseline, no molecular funnel. Base set: Chen2020 (deterministic anchor: no electrode system named in task -> protocol default; verified aging-capable: SEI kinetic rate constant 1e-12 m/s present). Ceiling assessment (opening): ED ceiling 521.7 Wh/kg (CEIL_ED) vs target 327.18 -> reachable in architecture space, no Stage-2 material escalation required. 4C plating: stock geometry plates (anode pot min -0.19 V DFN), rate-optimized probe CEIL_RATE reaches min +0.005 V (marginal) -> architecture+formulation space can fix 4C, needs margin. SEI@500: baseline 778 nm > 550 -> SEI kinetic rate constant reduction (coating bridge) to be mapped R2. lowT: protocol-defined warm-start; retention ~99% all probes (not binding).

note: ED 400.75 and SEI@100 449 pass; SEI@500 778 fails (>550); 4C plating (min ap -0.19V, charge acceptance ~0.18Ah).
